name: Michael Cytrynbaum
headline: Practice Director - Construction at Michael Page
about:
Michael Page International is a $2B global recruitment consultancy which has been established for over 35 years and has over 5000 employees in more than 30 countries. I lead the Construction team in Toronto and we specialize in the following sectors and positions:

- ICI Construction
- Residential Construction
- Civil Construction 
- Project Managers
- Site Superintendents
- Estimators

I have an economics degree and my background as a financial advisor working in the financial services industry allows me to take a consultative, solution based approach to fulfilling difficult recruitment needs. Also, having offices across the globe we are able to offer your complete market coverage for potential candidates.

For further information, please do not hesitate to contact me on 416-306-3918 or email me at mcytrynbaum@michaelpage.ca.
